weeks.question: 누구의 어떤 어려움인가?
weeks.required_behaviour: Build v0 quickly, preview, publish, observe 3 real users, store first hypothesis

weeks.question: 무엇이 나아지나? AI가 틀리면?
weeks.required_behaviour: AI Verify, repeated testing, failure/safety review, reuse/session evidence

weeks.question: 누가 돈을 내고 무엇이 바뀌나?
weeks.required_behaviour: Stakeholder model, payer/user distinction, impact metric, interview/channel experiments

weeks.question: 이미 있는 도움과 무엇이 다른가?
weeks.required_behaviour: Alternative-comparison experiment, version diff, user comparison testing

weeks.question: 어디까지 확인했나?
weeks.required_behaviour: Fact/assumption register, metrics, deck updates, weekly synthesis

weeks.question: 무엇을 만들고 무엇을 배웠나?
weeks.required_behaviour: Stable demo, version/evidence timeline, final deck, “belief changed because…” story
